Both candidates failed significantly on the core requirements of the prompt.

It also failed to address the 10-week freeze constraint or provide explicit abort/rollback criteria.

Both models provided generic 'plans' that ignored the specific constraints provided in the context (e.g., the lack of a shared integration environment and the specific handling of untested services).
